test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.

He blew out the candle and __went to sleepy. __
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) "went to sleep.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence written in the past tense, so the correct form of the verb "to sleep" is "slept."
 
• Option 1) correctly uses the past tense "went to sleep" to describe the action of the subject after blowing out the candle.
 
• Option 2) "go on sleep" is not a grammatically correct phrase.
 
• Option 3) "No improvement required" is not correct, as there is an error in the original sentence.
 
• Option 4) "gone to sleep" is the past participle form of the verb, and is not appropriate in this context. The simple past tense is required.
